families.label: Visuomotor rotation
families.about: Each line is one group of participants who reached to targets while the cursor was rotated by the same amount on the same schedule. Hand angles are flipped so that moving against the rotation is positive; 100% means the hand fully cancels the rotation.

measures.label: Early adaptation
measures.text: mean of feedback trials 2 to 11 of the first rotation block

measures.label: Late adaptation
measures.text: mean of the last 20 feedback trials of the first rotation block

measures.label: Aftereffect
measures.text: mean of the first 10 no-feedback trials right after that block, when such a block follows it

measures.label: Trials to half
measures.text: rotation trials until the group mean (5-trial moving average) first reaches half of its late value

families.label: Error clamp
families.about: Each line is one group of participants who saw a cursor that always moved at a fixed angle from the target, whatever their hand did, and were told to ignore it. Hand angles are flipped so that moving away from the clamp (implicit adaptation) is positive. Clamp sizes differ between studies; the size filter keeps one range.

measures.label: Early adaptation
measures.text: mean of feedback trials 2 to 11 of the first clamp block

measures.label: Late adaptation
measures.text: mean of the last 20 feedback trials of the first clamp block

measures.label: Aftereffect
measures.text: mean of the first 10 no-feedback trials right after that block, when such a block follows it

measures.label: Trials to half
measures.text: clamp trials until the group mean (5-trial moving average) first reaches half of its late value
